title: Wave Scrub
description: A precision scrubber over a song's waveform, coloured by its cover from first bar to last. Hover for the time and section, press to zoom the waveform around your finger, then drag at a fraction of the speed; release and it springs back out. Chapter markers follow the real shape of each song.
intent: Press-to-zoom scrubbing: the waveform magnifies under the pointer so a pixel covers a fraction of a second.
